case.pattern_description: Coordinated dormant-wake escalating online drain across 6 cards with no identity records: card C11663-K1 woke after at least 21 days without activity into 7 online ProductCD='C' charges (3660147, 3660148, 3660149, 3660150, 3660151, 3660152, 3660153) ramping $181.73 -> $357.82 -> $811.92 -> $1,800.00 -> $1,800.00 -> $1,800.00 -> $1,800.00 (total $8,551.47), matching 5 peer cards exhibiting the same doubling ramp.

evidence.claim: Customer C11663 reported not making the $1,800.00 transaction 3660153 on card C11663-K1.

Card C11663-K1 experienced an escalating series of 7 online Product C transactions without device identity records (3660147, 3660148, 3660149, 3660150, 3660151, 3660152, 3660153) ranging from $181.73 to $1,800.00 between 2017-01-22 and 2017-01-31, totaling $8,551.47.

The card's prior median transaction amount was $91.98 across 57 prior transactions, making the four $1,800.00 online charges (3660150, 3660151, 3660152, 3660153) an extreme departure from prior spending history.

Recurring charge check for transaction 3660153 returned 3 transactions with a median gap of 0.93 days, failing the R7 policy threshold requiring at least 5 prior transactions with a median gap of 5–35 days.
Transaction 3660153 occurred in known billing region 315.0 (9 prior transactions) using the customer's usual email domain yahoo.com (48 prior uses).

case.summary: This case is assessed as fraud with a probability of 0.94 following customer C11663's denial of transaction 3660153 ($1,800.00). The activity fits an undocumented coordinated dormant-wake pattern, where card C11663-K1 woke after weeks of silence into 7 online charges without device telemetry escalating to $1,800.00 (total exposure $8,551.47), matching peer cards C04096-K1 and C07847-K1. Recommending card block and filing a SAR under Policy R2 and R9 pending L2 manager approval, alongside automatic case creation, peer monitoring, and escalation.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed under internal case reference AC-HHF-003 to report an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern involving a dormant-wake escalating online drain. The subject of this investigation is customer C11663 and debit mastercard C11663-K1, which exhibits a coordinated pattern linked to peer cards C04096-K1, C07847-K1, C08563-K1, C09026-K1, and C09148-K1. Following over three weeks of card inactivity, online Product C transactions commenced without device identity records on 2017-01-22 at 12:55 for $181.73 in billing region 327.0 (transaction 3660147), on 2017-01-23 at 07:25 for $357.82 in billing region 327.0 (transaction 3660148), and on 2017-01-24 at 19:13 for $811.92 in billing region 327.0 (transaction 3660149). The activity then escalated to repeated maximum charges of $1,800.00 online on 2017-01-26 at 19:51 in billing region 327.0 (transaction 3660150), on 2017-01-27 at 19:12 in billing region 327.0 (transaction 3660151), on 2017-01-28 at 17:31 in billing region 327.0 (transaction 3660152), and on 2017-01-31 at 17:31 in billing region 315.0 (transaction 3660153). This rapid progression of online charges without device telemetry replicates a coordinated doubling ramp pattern observed across peer cards C04096-K1, C07847-K1, C08563-K1, C09026-K1, and C09148-K1. This spending behavior is highly unusual compared to the cardholder's baseline prior to case opening of 57 prior transactions with a median transaction amount of $91.98. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. The agent opened internal case AC-HHF-003, initiated monitoring on connected cards, and escalated the case to an analyst; a block of card C11663-K1 is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, and filing of this report is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious exposure of $8,551.47.
